correctness.rationale: From pinned RESULT.md a61db65fdd840e40ab4ceaf0f3920a40619f1112, for two singular values m=sigma_min^2,h=sigma_max^2, ||SQ||_F^2=m+h gives kappa^2=F/m-1. E optimality increases m while maximum/minimum two-row Frobenius mass ratio is <=rho; divide by kappa_D^2>=1 to get sqrt(2rho-1). At rho=1 fixed F makes the objectives equivalent including ties. Constructed u_n,v_n orthonormal with disjoint supports and leverage ratio n; all full-rank selections have diagonal magnitudes (sqrt(n),2),(sqrt(n),1),(1,2),(1,1); unique E pair has kappa sqrt(n)/2, D pair one. A=u v^T+v u^T+2(I-uu^T-vv^T) yields A u=v and a genuine symmetric two-step Krylov basis. Independently checked 150 random frames and the exact family n=5,6,9,15; computation corroborates, does not prove all n.
